rationale: Price is sitting exactly at today's high after a 4.85% gap-up on positive news catalyst, with the last 5 candles showing a sharp pullback from 13.19 to 13.03 before recovering back to 13.19 — this whipsaw at the high suggests distribution pressure rather than clean continuation.
